{{Quote|The Sith are the enemies of life itself, yet I will allow that isolated and accidental good can sometimes result from their rule. The religious war that has devastated Sarrassia since the rule of Chancellor Am-Ris is reportedly at an end under the rule of Lord Bactra, who has kept the Grumani Hierophants in check and barred Spumani Crusaders from pursuing their typically sanguinary quests. Though Bactra cares only for the planet's deposits of Sarrassian iron, I am grateful for any circumstance that lessens bloodshed.|[[Vannar Treece]]|<ref name="Knight Errant Gazetteer" />}}
'''Sarrassia''' was a [[Planet/Legends|world]] in the [[Sarrassia system/Legends|Sarrassia system]], in the [[Grumani sector/Legends|Grumani sector]]. It was a known source of [[Sarrassian iron/Legends|Sarrassian iron]].
{{Planet-stub}}

==History==
===Cold War===
[[File:Am-Ris.jpg|150px|thumb|[[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Paran Am-Ris]], during whose term the religious war of Sarrassia started.]]
During the term of [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Paran Am-Ris]], a religious war started on Sarrassia that ravaged the planet for more than two and a half millennia.<ref name="Knight Errant Gazetteer" />

===New Sith Wars===
During the [[Republic Dark Age]], the war was reported to be [[Conquest of Sarrassia|ended]] by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Ayanos Bactra]]. Bactra succeeded in keeping the [[Grumani Hierophant]]s in check and barring [[Spumani Crusader]]s from pursuing their typically [[Blood/Legends|sanguinary]] quests, although he cared only for the planet's deposits of [[Sarrassian iron/Legends|Sarrassian iron]].<ref name="Knight Errant Gazetteer" />
